description: This file contains pytest-based test cases for testing FastAPI endpoints within a project. It uses fixtures to instantiate a test client dynamically importing modules, and includes tests for API responses, redirects, and OpenAPI schema validation.

methods.name: get_client(request: pytest.FixtureRequest)
methods.description: Pytest fixture that dynamically imports the appropriate module based on test parameters and returns a FastAPI test client.

methods.name: test_get_portal(client: TestClient)
methods.description: Tests the '/portal' GET endpoint to ensure it returns status 200 and the correct JSON message.

methods.name: test_get_redirect(client: TestClient)
methods.description: Tests redirect behavior when calling '/portal' with a teleport parameter, ensuring a 307 status and correct 'location' header.

methods.name: test_openapi_schema(client: TestClient)
methods.description: Validates that the OpenAPI schema returned by '/openapi.json' matches the expected structure and content.
